scenarios.scenario: Open website; choose manual directly
scenarios.expected: Manual order works; no mic capture, dispatch or unsolicited audio

scenarios.scenario: Enable spoken welcome; say nothing initially
scenarios.expected: One prompt asking voice/manual after readiness, without needing “hello”

scenarios.scenario: Say “manual please” / “I'll do it myself”
scenarios.expected: Playback/tips stop, tracks end, dispatch cleanup reconciles, shopping remains intact

scenarios.scenario: Say “voice”; ask for spicy food under 1,000
scenarios.expected: Correct real filters, matching visible items and grounded concise reply

scenarios.scenario: “Where am I?” / “Read this page”
scenarios.expected: Current route/selection/results/actions, no fabricated page or exhaustive irrelevant dump

scenarios.scenario: “Open the second one”; “press add to cart”
scenarios.expected: Exact presented item opens/adds through semantic operations; verified total spoken

scenarios.scenario: “Add two”; interrupt with “actually make it one”
scenarios.expected: Final quantity one with matching UI and no duplicated add

scenarios.scenario: Change page/filter/item manually during reply
scenarios.expected: Obsolete guidance stops; current context wins; stale references clarify

scenarios.scenario: Ask details/recommendations/comparison with unknown ingredients
scenarios.expected: Uses verified facts and states missing information plainly

scenarios.scenario: “Repeat”, “slower”, “back”, “undo”, “stop”
scenarios.expected: Each supported control performs its real behavior; no unrelated mutation

scenarios.scenario: Request checkout; silence, casual yes, correction or interrupted summary
scenarios.expected: No submission without explicit current-summary authorization

scenarios.scenario: Confirm fully delivered current summary
scenarios.expected: Exactly one demo receipt, actual total and truthful simulated-order acknowledgment

scenarios.scenario: Edit cart after summary or use token from another session
scenarios.expected: Confirmation invalidated/refused; fresh review required

scenarios.scenario: Duplicate action/start request; simultaneous manual/voice edits
scenarios.expected: One effect/dispatch; deterministic result; no overwritten newer state

scenarios.scenario: Commit order then drop response
scenarios.expected: Retrieve original outcome by ID; no new order/retry or invented failure

scenarios.scenario: Mic denied, autoplay blocked, provider unavailable
scenarios.expected: Accurate state, actionable recovery, usable existing manual cart

scenarios.scenario: Voice → typed → manual → voice
scenarios.expected: Same shopping session; correct microphone/audio state; brief resume

scenarios.scenario: Disconnect/reconnect/reload/end during work
scenarios.expected: Latest supported state restored, no stale replay or late unsolicited speech

scenarios.scenario: Two shoppers / tabs with distinct sessions
scenarios.expected: No shared cart, context, transcript, token or receipt leakage

scenarios.scenario: Natural varied phrasing, noise and hesitations
scenarios.expected: Comfortable dialogue; uncertainty clarified; measured failures retained

scenarios.scenario: Keyboard/screen reader with assistant active
scenarios.expected: Core order and mode exit accessible; no focus trap or announcement flood

scenarios.scenario: Open website with all agent services disconnected.
scenarios.expected: Home, menu, cart and demo checkout remain usable manually.

scenarios.scenario: Choose manual browsing at first visit.
scenarios.expected: No mic request/autoplay; user can immediately shop.

scenarios.scenario: Keyboard-only full demo order.
scenarios.expected: All essential controls work, focus remains visible/logical and confirmation is reachable.

scenarios.scenario: Search/filter vegetarian and price max 800, then clear.
scenarios.expected: Actual catalog results and count change; app context matches displayed filters/results.

scenarios.scenario: Select a product, edit a valid option if offered, add quantity two.
scenarios.expected: Correct item/options and calculated prices appear in one shared cart.

scenarios.scenario: Manually reduce quantity or remove a line.
scenarios.expected: Cart and total change accurately; user receives readable/accessibility feedback.

scenarios.scenario: Attempt empty cart checkout or invalid quantity/unavailable item.
scenarios.expected: Action refused with actionable error, no fake success.

scenarios.scenario: Complete valid manual checkout with explicit current-summary confirmation.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one **simulated** order is recorded/shown; no real payment claims.

scenarios.scenario: Trigger a page/item change while a mock agent is subscribed.
scenarios.expected: `app.context_updated` emits the latest route/item and a higher revision.

scenarios.scenario: Inject mock `agent.action_request` for `filter_menu`/`select_item`.
scenarios.expected: Real menu view/selection changes through shared operations; factual results are returned.

scenarios.scenario: Inject `cart.add_item` followed by `cart.set_quantity` absolute quantity=1.
scenarios.expected: One verified final line quantity=1, coherent cart total and correlated `app.action_result`s.

scenarios.scenario: Repeat the same mutating `action_id` / same request.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate add/submit effect; prior outcome can be reconciled.

scenarios.scenario: Inject a request using a stale `context_revision` or invalid `item_id`.
scenarios.expected: Safe refusal/revalidation with proper reason; newer UI state is not overwritten.

scenarios.scenario: Mock checkout request before explicit confirmation, then alter the cart.
scenarios.expected: `requires_confirmation`/rejection; old approval invalidated; updated summary required.

scenarios.scenario: Simulate `timeout/unknown` on a demo-order submission.
scenarios.expected: No automatic second order; pending/uncertain state can be reconciled by `action_id`.

scenarios.scenario: Mock `agent.status` for connect → listen → speak → pause → error.
scenarios.expected: UI displays correct product-facing states and remains keyboard accessible.

scenarios.scenario: Inject user interim/final transcript with same `turn_id`, then interrupted assistant text.
scenarios.expected: Partial is replaced rather than duplicated; unheard assistant continuation is not represented as delivered.

scenarios.scenario: Enter typed help/request while assistance UI is active.
scenarios.expected: Correct `app.text_input` envelope is emitted; no fake microphone/STT claim.

scenarios.scenario: Manual cart edit during a simulated agent response, then request `get_current_context`.
scenarios.expected: Fresh result reflects manual edit; no separate agent cart.

scenarios.scenario: Mock disconnect or denied microphone permission.
scenarios.expected: User can exit/pause the assistant and complete the **existing** cart manually.

scenarios.scenario: Switch from manual → simulated assisted → manual.
scenarios.expected: Navigation/cart progress retained; unsolicited assistant guidance stops after exit.

scenarios.scenario: Zoom/enlarge text, navigate with screen reader, trigger async cart updates.
scenarios.expected: Key content reflows; controls are named; status information is intelligible without announcement spam.

scenarios.scenario: Opt into voice; say nothing.
scenarios.expected: Agent speaks the welcome by itself once ready.

scenarios.scenario: Stay silent after the welcome.
scenarios.expected: Offers limited contextual help, then remains quiet/ready rather than looping.

scenarios.scenario: Interrupt the greeting with “Show burgers.”
scenarios.expected: Greeting stops; a current `filter_menu`/navigation request is emitted.

scenarios.scenario: Pause naturally while saying “I want… maybe a spicy… burger.”
scenarios.expected: Does not consistently cut off the unfinished thought.

scenarios.scenario: Ask “Vegetarian under eight hundred.”
scenarios.expected: Valid structured filter request; speaks results supplied by mock app.

scenarios.scenario: After listing results say “the second one.”
scenarios.expected: Uses the correct current result ID and requests item selection.

scenarios.scenario: Say “Add two” then “actually make it one.”
scenarios.expected: Correct confirmed quantity=1, with no duplicate mutations.

scenarios.scenario: Return a failed add-to-cart result.
scenarios.expected: Assistant does not announce that the item was added.

scenarios.scenario: Ask “Where am I?” after GUI navigates manually.
scenarios.expected: Describes the current new page, not stale conversation memory.

scenarios.scenario: Say “Stop”, “Repeat”, “Go back”, and “Slower.”
scenarios.expected: Controls work in the applicable states without an unrelated LLM hallucination.

scenarios.scenario: Ask to checkout; remain silent when asked to confirm.
scenarios.expected: No order submitted.

scenarios.scenario: Explicitly confirm current checkout summary.
scenarios.expected: Only one authorized **demo** submission; speaks actual returned result.

scenarios.scenario: Interrupt checkout confirmation with a cart change.
scenarios.expected: Earlier confirmation invalidated; revised summary requested.

scenarios.scenario: Simulate a delayed/unknown action result.
scenarios.expected: Does not duplicate the action or falsely report success.

scenarios.scenario: Deny microphone permission or mute audio.
scenarios.expected: Text/normal browsing fallback, honest status.

scenarios.scenario: Type a menu request instead of speaking.
scenarios.expected: Same interpretation/action route works without microphone input.

scenarios.scenario: Cause Deepgram/LLM/TTS provider failure.
scenarios.expected: Graceful recoverable feedback where feasible; no misleading UI state.

scenarios.scenario: Speak with common regional pronunciation/noisy mic.
scenarios.expected: Recognition limitations logged; consequential uncertainty clarified.

scenarios.scenario: Say “I'll browse myself.”
scenarios.expected: Stops unsolicited voice guidance; confirmed app/cart state remains intact.

scenarios.scenario: Interrupt while a cart mutation is in flight.
scenarios.expected: Audio stops; final cart status is reconciled via matching action ID/result.
